title: Day 708 — Sheinbaum Presents 2027 Economic Package at National Palace, Announces Digital Economy Law to Curb Cash Use
detail: On September 9, 2026 (Day 708, Wednesday), President Sheinbaum presented the 2027 Economic Package at her mañanera in the National Palace, a day after Finance Secretary Édgar Amador Zamora formally delivered it to the Chamber of Deputies. Sheinbaum reiterated that the package "no contempla nuevos impuestos ni va a haber gasolinazos" (contemplates no new taxes and no fuel-price shocks), framing it as "responsible" and protective of welfare, health and education spending while pursuing gradual fiscal consolidation and reinforced anti-tax-evasion enforcement rather than new levies. She announced a new Digital Economy Law would be sent to Congress alongside the package, aimed at gradually reducing cash usage in commercial transactions through phased targets and timelines, promoting secure digital payment platforms, and providing incentives and training tools to help micro and small businesses adopt electronic collection methods without hurting their income. Sheinbaum said Finance Secretary Amador would detail the macroeconomic criteria, revenue initiatives and small-business support programs at her mañaneras on September 11 and 12. Officials confirmed the package projects total net spending of 10.636 trillion pesos, revenue of 9.157 trillion pesos, a deficit equal to 3.9% of GDP, and 2027 GDP growth of 1.5%–2.5%.
